wrapper.tick_definition: step() calls the game's own loop() until the game's own throttle counter `window.count` returns to 0 -- the tick length is READ FROM THE GAME, not assumed
wrapper.input_path: a move is a dispatched `keydown` (keyCode/which 37..40), so it passes through the game's own handler and its no-backtrack rule
wrapper.state_path: read from the live page's top-level vars (snake, apple, grid, canvas, count); NOT scraped from pixels

rng.call_site: Math.random, whose only consumer in the page is getRandomInt

browser.digest_scope: sha256 of the browser BINARY FILE, first 16 hex

instrument.episode_clock: one step == one tick; no wall-clock time enters the game

entrant_digest_scope: sha256 of the model FILE, first 16 hex. THE ENTRANT IS THE THING BEING MEASURED, so it is identified by a digest; `entrant` is a label for reading, not for checking.

config.mmproj_how: longest common prefix with the weight filename (20 chars)
config.reasoning_declared_in: snake_run.py (declared here; the pattern and the measurement are PREREG_sokoban.md's)
config.reasoning_rationale: Snake's answer is ONE LETTER, the same case as Sokoban and Missile Command: a thinking model puts its deliberation where the answer belongs and the token ceiling eats it -- measured on unchanged weights at 2,314 tokens with no move. DARTS is the opposite case (exact arithmetic) and is not this cabinet.
config.legend:
You are playing Snake on a board {w} cells wide and {h} cells tall. The board wraps around, so sliding off the right edge brings you back on the left and sliding off the bottom brings you back on the top. There are no walls, and the only way to lose is to run into your own body.

On the map below a dot is an empty cell, a small letter o is one segment of your body, a capital letter O is your head, and a capital letter A is the apple you are trying to eat. The first line of the map is the top row of the board and the first character of each line is its leftmost cell.

{board}

Your head is at row {row}, column {col}, counting from zero. You are currently moving {heading}. Your body is {length} cells long and you have eaten {eaten} apples so far.

Answer with a single letter: R to move right, U to move up, D to move down, or L to move left. You may add an explanation after your answer, and it will be ignored.

reasoning_probe.question: What is 2 + 2? Reply with just the number and nothing else.
reasoning_probe.observed: thinking OFF -- a one-token question answered in a few tokens
